pages.lesson:
LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading Aloud: Fluency (2 sessions) • Adjectives (descriptive words)
Topic 2.9: Extensive Reading: Library Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Extensive Reading: Library Skills. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we easily and safely locate places in our environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. select a reading text from a collection of materials
2. track the reading progress for self- assessment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. select a reading text from a collection of materials
   In simple words: practise until you can select a reading text from a collection of materials. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. track the reading progress for self- assessment
   In simple words: practise until you can track the reading progress for self- assessment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Extensive Reading: Library Skills using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Extensive Reading: Library Skills in the examples.
2. Explain Extensive Reading: Library Skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
4. Show that you can: select a reading text from a collection of materials

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Extensive Reading: Library Skills using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Extensive Reading: Library Skills important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Team up to discuss issues to consider when selecting a reading text from a collection of materials,
2. Read a text aloud on locating places and the locality and talk about it,
3. Communication and Collaboration: This is promoted as the learner expresses their ideas confidently when discussing issues to consider when selecting a reading text from a collection of materials

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we easily and safely locate places in our environment?
2. Why should we keep a record of texts read?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. select a reading text from a collection of materials
2. track the reading progress for self- assessment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
